name: Eleazar
bio: Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite was one of David's Three mightiest warriors. When the Israelite army fled from the Philistines at a battle, Eleazar stood his ground and kept striking down Philistines until his hand grew so tired it froze to his sword; the LORD brought about a great victory that day, and the rest of the troops returned only to strip the dead (2 Samuel 23:9-10). Eleazar was also among the three who later broke through a Philistine camp to bring David water from the well of Bethlehem, a gift David found too precious to drink and poured out to the LORD instead (2 Samuel 23:13-17).
